mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST ( POST_SEQ, USR_ID, POST_TTL, POST_CN, POST_STAT, VIS_TYP, POST_DTM, FRST_REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{postSeq}, #{command.usrId}, NULL, #{command.content}, 'ACTIVE', #{command.visibility}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{command.frstRegUserId} )
INSERT INTO TB_COMM_POST_FILE ( POST_SEQ, FIL_SEQ, SORT_ORD, MEDIA_TYP, FRST_REG_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{postSeq}, #{filSeq}, #{sortOrder}, #{mediaType}, #{command.frstRegUserId} )
mapper.select: SELECT P.POST_SEQ AS postSeq , P.USR_ID AS authorId , U.USR_NM AS authorName , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS profileImageFilSeq , P.POST_CN AS content , to_char(P.POST_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ ) AS likeCount , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_CMT C WHERE C.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND C.CMT_STAT = 'ACTIVE' ) AS commentCount , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND L.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) AS likedByMe , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND S.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) AS savedByMe FROM TB_COMM_POST P JOIN TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = P.USR_ID WHERE P.POST_STAT = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (#{feedType} = 'mine' AND P.USR_ID = #{usrId}) OR ( #{feedType} = 'saved' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_SAVE S WHERE S.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND S.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) AND ( P.VIS_TYP = 'PUBLIC' OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = 'ACCEPTED' ) ) ) OR ( #{feedType} NOT IN ('mine', 'saved') AND ( P.VIS_TYP = 'PUBLIC' OR P.USR_ID = #{usrId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = 'ACCEPTED' ) ) ) ) AND ( #{feedType} IN ('mine', 'saved') OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_POST_SEEN V WHERE V.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ AND V.USR_ID = #{usrId} ) ) AND ( #{feedType} <> 'following' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = 'ACCEPTED' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{feedType} IN ('mine', 'popular', 'saved') THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_COMM_FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWER_USR_ID = #{usrId} AND F.FOLLOWING_USR_ID = P.USR_ID AND F.FOLLOW_STAT = 'ACCEPTED' ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN #{feedType} = 'popular' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMM_POST_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_SEQ = P.POST_SEQ ) ELSE 0 END DESC, P.POST_DTM DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT PF.FIL_SEQ AS filSeq , PF.MEDIA_TYP AS mediaType , D.CONT_TYP AS contentType FROM TB_COMM_POST_FILE PF JOIN FIL_DTL D ON D.FIL_SEQ = PF.FIL_SEQ WHERE PF.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} ORDER BY PF.SORT_ORD

SELECT C.CMT_SEQ AS cmtSeq , C.PARENT_CMT_SEQ AS parentCmtSeq , C.USR_ID AS usrId , U.USR_NM AS usrNm , U.PRFL_IMG_FIL_SEQ AS profileImageFilSeq , C.CMT_CN AS cmtCn , TO_CHAR(C.CMT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS cmtDtm , (C.CMT_STAT = 'DELETED') AS deleted FROM TB_COMM_CMT C JOIN TB_USR U ON U.USR_ID = C.USR_ID WHERE C.POST_SEQ = #{postSeq} AND C.CMT_STAT IN ('ACTIVE', 'DELETED') ORDER BY C.CMT_DTM
